parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the clean-room restriction, the need to imitate 7za CLI behavior, and broad support for 7z, zip, tar, gzip, xz, bzip2, hash commands, encryption, and extraction/listing/test commands.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent wrote a SPEC and fixed headers, created compile.sh and a placeholder main.cpp, and launched one four-child codec wave for Hash/AES, LZMA decode, LZMA encode, and Deflate/Inflate. CLI/archive assembly was left for a later wave that never executed.
parallel.implementation: Two children completed Hash/AES and Deflate/Inflate modules with local tests. LZMA decoder and encoder files were written but still under active debugging or failing against real 7-Zip when cancelled.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact contained the partial source tree, compile.sh, reference/work files, the original executable, and a placeholder src/main.cpp rather than an assembled 7za-compatible program.
parallel.verification: Completed children ran substantial local harnesses, but there was no parent whole-program build/test after the swarm, and the LZMA encoder explicitly still failed real-binary checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run ended during the first AgentSwarm wave with two aborted LZMA children, no CLI/archive implementation, no final integration pass, and only 6 of 1085 official tests passing.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same clean-room constraints and the broad 7-Zip behavioral surface, including commands, formats, output text, and archive internals.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It used a single-agent plan with todos for probing, parsing, scaffold, CLI, hashers, archives, formats, and verification, but it kept the active work on probing and scratch analysis.
serial.implementation: It wrote exploratory scripts such as 7z parsers and LZMA debugging tools under /tmp, but it did not create the submission source tree, compile.sh, or a replacement executable implementation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact consisted essentially of the original workspace files and documentation, without buildable source or compile instructions for the required reimplementation.
serial.verification: It verified many observations against the reference binary while probing, but did not run verification on a submitted implementation because no implementation was delivered.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out during LZMA analysis with implementation todos still pending; official evaluation therefore failed at compile time with all 1085 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the need for a clean-room 7za replacement and probed many CLI and format behaviors before writing a SPEC.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same broad clean-room 7-Zip requirements and probed the same command and format categories.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no material requirement mismatch; the difference was that parallel converted some requirements into component work while serial remained in discovery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into a parent scaffolding phase and a four-child codec/crypto implementation wave, with a later CLI/archive wave only planned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all work with the single main actor and used todos to track probing, analysis, design, implementation, and verification stages.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained component implementation throughput but left final entrypoint/CLI assembly without an executed owner; serial had no delegation boundary but also no delivered implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel supplied children with SPEC.md and fixed headers, plus explicit file ownership and local compile-check rules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated context directly in one main trajectory through notes, parsers, and command probes, without handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had formal component interfaces but its parent did not reach the later stage that would use them for an executable; serial avoided interface handoffs but never transformed context into source.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote actual C++ modules for hashing, AES, LZMA decode/encode, and Deflate/Inflate, with two modules completed and two still unstable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote scratch Python analysis tools and minimal LZMA experiments, not the final C++ implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced partial deliverable code; serial produced analysis artifacts only, which explains the compile-failed official result for serial and the low but nonzero score for parallel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched children and received an aggregate swarm result only as cancellation occurred, with two completed and two aborted children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve or join; all evidence stayed in the single main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child lifecycle failure on indispensable LZMA work, while serial's failure was not a child-result lifecycle issue.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote all children into one shared source tree but kept nominal file ownership; the final artifact had the shared partial tree and placeholder entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation showed only the original repository/documentation and no generated source tree or compile script.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel integration failed at final assembly after partial shared-code creation; serial did not reach a shared implementation state at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children ran local component tests, but parent-level integrated acceptance never occurred and LZMA encoder real-binary verification still failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified observations of the reference binary, but not a submitted implementation; the official evaluator failed at compilation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had component-level checks but no final executable acceptance; serial had behavioral probes only and no implementation acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel exhausted the run while blocked in the first codec swarm; cancellation ended the parent and two active children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial exhausted the run while still analyzing LZMA details, with implementation and verification todos pending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel's budget was consumed inside a child wave while serial's budget was consumed by serial probing before implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail, not discordant. Parallel reached a buildable partial source tree and passed 6 of 1085 tests, but it had no assembled CLI/archive implementation and lost unfinished LZMA child work. Serial never delivered compileable replacement source, so its official evaluation failed at compile time with all tests not run.
parallel_contributors: Partial C++ modules and compile.sh were present, allowing the evaluator to compile and run enough behavior to pass six tests.
The placeholder entry point and aborted LZMA children left the parallel deliverable far short of the required 7za behavior.
serial_contributors: The single-agent run remained in probing and scratch parser/debugging work through timeout.
Its submitted artifact lacked generated source and compile.sh, leading to compile_failed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel attempted broad component implementation; serial focused on reverse-engineering and did not implement the final program.
evaluator_effects: Serial's pass count is zero because compile_failed prevented the 1085 tests from running; parallel's low score came from an incomplete executable rather than evaluator incompleteness.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative explanation for different failure modes inside the both-fail result
